newsitem.title: GERMANY: Waigel evacuated from holiday hotel after threat.
newsitem.headline: Waigel evacuated from holiday hotel after threat.

text.p: German Finance Minister Theo Waigel and 75 guests were evacuated from a hotel at a German holiday resort on the Baltic coast early on Tuesday because of a bomb threat, police said on Wednesday.
The bomb threat was called into the Ahlbecker Hof hotel on the island of Usedom shortly after 3 a.m. (0100 GMT) and the entire hotel was evacuated, police in the town of Anklam said.
No bomb was found and the hotel guests were allowed to return shortly after 6 a.m.

A 23-year-old man was arrested on suspicion of making the threat. Police were able to trace the call, made from a mobile telephone, because the caller's number was visible on the hotel clerk's telephone display panel.
